### Geographic Reach {#geo-rep}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("scripts", "_setup.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "load-data.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "overview.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("scripts", "map.R"), echo = FALSE)

library(showtext)
showtext_auto()  # Enables custom fonts in ggplot2

# Register Lato font
font_add_google("Lato", "Lato")
```

Members are connecting from **`r n_distinct(IP_address$COUNTRY[!is.na(IP_address$COUNTRY) & !is.na(IP_address$who_region)])` countries**, based on IP address data. This provides a practical proxy for member distribution, though it may differ from self-reported country of residence. Data may reflect variance in locations due to travel or VPN use.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-align: left
#| out.width: 100%

# Static reporting date
report_date <- as.Date("2025-11-25")

# Categorize user counts into custom bins
user_points$category <- cut(
  user_points$user_count,
  breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 50, Inf),
  labels = c("1–10", "11–20", "21–50", "51+"),
  right = TRUE,
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

# Custom palette
custom_colors <- c(
  "1–10" = "#00205C",
  "11–20" = "#009ADE",
  "21–50" = "#F4A81D",
  "51+"   = "#80BC00"
)

# Hover text
user_points$hover_label <- paste0(
  "<b>", user_points$COUNTRY, "</b><br>",
  "Users: ", user_points$user_count
)

# Base ggplot
map_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sfs$adm0, fill = "#F8F9FA", color = "#D0D0D0", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(
    data = user_points,
    aes(size = user_count, fill = category, text = hover_label),
    shape = 21, color = "#2F3E46", alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 15), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, name = "User Volume", drop = FALSE) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 6),
    title.position = "top",
    title.hjust = 0.5
  )) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#2F3E46", size = 11, family = "Lato"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#2F3E46", size = 10, family = "Lato"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# Convert to interactive Plotly with custom title and subtitle
ggplotly(map_plot, tooltip = "text") %>%
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    margin = list(t = 60, b = 20, l = 20, r = 20),  # Top margin increased for title space
    annotations = list(
      list(
        text = "<b>Member Access by Country</b>",
        x = 0, y = 1.12,
        xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(family = "Lato", size = 14, color = "#2F3E46"),
        xanchor = "left"
      ),
      list(
        text = glue("<i>As of {format(report_date, '%d %B %Y')}</i>"),
        x = 0, y = 1.05,
        xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(family = "Lato", size = 12, color = "#2F3E46"),
        xanchor = "left"
      )
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = -0.25
    ),
    xaxis = list(visible = FALSE, fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(visible = FALSE, fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
    plot_bgcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'
  ) %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

### Regional Reach

All WHO regions are represented among Collaboratory members. The charts show the percentage of members in each region, as well as the distribution of represented countries across regions.

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 2
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| out.width: 100%

custom_palette <- c("#80BC00", "#00205C", "#009ADE", "#A6228C", "#F26829", "#F4A81D")


region_summary_filtered <- region_summary %>%
  mutate(
    prop_members = n_members / sum(n_members) * 100,
    who_region = fct_reorder(who_region, prop_members, .desc = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(region_summary_filtered, aes(x = 1, y = prop_members, fill = who_region)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.3, color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop_members, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette) +
  labs(
    title = "Member Distribution by Region",
    subtitle = glue("As of {format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = ""
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, family = "Lato", face = "italic", color = "#2F3E46"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, family = "Lato", face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Lato"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
  )


```

### Institutions {#int-rep}

Collaboratory members come from **300+ institutions worldwide**, based on email domain data. The chart shows the proportion of members with WHO-affiliated addresses (@who.int) compared with other institutions. While WHO staff make up a significant share, the platform also includes a broader network of global health professionals and organizations.

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 2
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

# Static reporting date
report_date <- as.Date("2025-11-25")

# Recreate filtered_users locally for the bar chart
filtered_users <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email")))

# Count WHO vs Non-WHO members
email_counts <- filtered_users %>%
  mutate(domain = ifelse(grepl("@who\\.int$", email), "WHO Members", "Non-WHO Members")) %>%
  count(domain) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
    domain = factor(domain, levels = c("WHO Members", "Non-WHO Members"))
  )

ggplot(email_counts, aes(x = 1, y = prop_percent, fill = domain)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.3, color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop_percent, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "WHO Members" = "#F4A81D",
      "Non-WHO Members" = "#00205C"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of WHO-affiliated Members",
    subtitle = glue("As of {format(report_date, '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = ""
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, family = "Lato", face = "italic", color = "#2F3E46"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, family = "Lato", face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Lato"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
  )
```

### Disciplines {#dis-rep}

Member disciplinary information is **currently unreported**. Collecting data on members’ professional roles and expertise is planned to provide insights into the range of disciplines represented across the Collaboratory community.

### Gender Distribution {#gen-ratio}

Gender information for members is **currently unreported**. Collecting these data will help monitor diversity and inclusivity across the Collaboratory community.
